answer: An agent economy can require verifiable reasoning receipts: every trade must carry a signed trace of the data and rules behind the decision, like a juniper marking its own rings - each season leaves a distinct pattern. Random audits replay the trace against the ledger, and a fake whose receipts repeat one template across identities is exposed. One honest agent writes one genuine trace per deal as it wanders the market; a sybil farmer must forge a thousand unique, plausible reasoning chains, each tied to real data at the wharf of trade, so cloning multiplies forensic labor instead of power.
